issues.json_path: staffing.oh_mixed60[1].notes / staffing.oh_passport100[0].notes / opex[Training] / staffing.*[Client care supervisor] notes
issues.current: Aides need 6 hours annual in-service (cited to 5160-46-04). Supervisor has no credential requirement. 'ODH nonmedical rules reviewed set no supervisor credential.' Supervisor is $46,000 with no RN/LPN.
issues.correct: Under 5160-46-04 the 6-hour in-service applies to NON-AGENCY aides. Agency aides need 8 hours of in-service within 12 months, first-aid certification, and a certificate from an ODH-approved or Medicare aide competency program. They must also be supervised by a licensed RN or LPN, with a face-to-face home visit at least every 60 days. The agency must be Medicare-certified or otherwise accredited.
issues.evidence: Rule text: agency aides must "Maintain evidence of the completion of eight hours of in-service continuing education" and "Receive supervision from a licensed RN or a licensed LPN", with a home visit "at least every sixty days".
issues.fix: For any Ohio Home Care Waiver or ODM-billed revenue, change the in-service figure to 8 hours for agency aides and add first-aid certification and competency-program costs. Replace the unlicensed $46,000 'client care supervisor' with RN/LPN-credentialed supervision and wage it at RN/LPN rates. Add the Medicare certification or accreditation cost. Also correct the cite: 5160-46-04 is the Ohio Home Care Waiver rule, not PASSPORT. PASSPORT aides fall under ODA rule 173-39 (S32), and the model never retrieved its enacted text.

issues.current: Only the 'personal care at least five days a week' coverage rule is listed. The 2 FTE (mixed) and 1 FTE (20-client owner-run) supervisor counts are not checked against it.
issues.correct: Rule 173-3-06.5(B)(3) also requires a back-up plan when no PCA is available. It requires a PCA supervisor to be available during ALL hours when PCAs are scheduled. It sets PCA initial qualifications: STNA, Medicare aide standards, 1 year of experience plus a competency evaluation, or at least 30 hours of training with competency evaluation. It also requires 6 hours of ODA-approved in-service every 12 months and licensure under ORC 3740 / OAC 3701-60.
issues.evidence: Rule: provider shall maintain "The availability of a PCA supervisor during all hours when PCAs are scheduled to work."
issues.fix: Add an on-call or after-hours supervisor stipend or extra FTE so a supervisor is reachable whenever aides are scheduled. Add a back-up aide plan, which means paid standby capacity. Add the cost of pre-service 30-hour training or competency evaluation for non-STNA hires, and pay for that training time. Add the 6-hour in-service as paid wage hours (about 6 hrs × $16.57 per aide per year). The current 4% non-billable factor covers travel only.

issues.current: Benefits 3% of payroll. The 100-client PASSPORT model has about 6,240 aide hours per month plus 7 salaried staff, and no ACA employer-coverage cost.
issues.evidence: Computed: 100 clients × 62.4 paid hours = 6,240 hrs/month. At 130 hrs/month per FTE that is 48 aide FTEs. Adding administrator, 3 supervisors and 3 schedulers gives about 55 FTEs, above the 50-FTE ACA applicable-large-employer threshold. This is my calculation, not a retrieved source.
issues.fix: For oh_passport100 at full census, add an ACA employer-mandate or health-coverage cost line, or document how the agency stays under 50 FTEs. Flag the 3% benefits estimate as unverified.

issues.current: No overtime premium and no aide mileage reimbursement. Non-billable time is limited to 4% for travel.
issues.evidence: The ODA sheet itself carries separate overtime unit rates (HCAS PC OT $7.05 vs $4.70). Overtime is a real payer and employer cost. Opex has 'Supervisor mileage' only, and nothing for aide mileage between clients.
issues.fix: Add an overtime allowance (for example 3–5% of aide hours at 1.5×). Add aide mileage or travel reimbursement and the FLSA third-party-employer overtime obligation to the cost model. Mark both as operator estimates.

issues.current: 'Home care attendant (HCAS/N)... Personal care aide tasks are included in the unit rate.'

issues.evidence: Rule 5160-46-06.1: "There is no base rate for HCAS/PC. The HCAS/PC service can only be rendered in conjunction with an HCAS/N service."
issues.fix: Relabel the row as a nursing-task HCAS rate. It is outside non-medical scope. Do not use $6.39 for personal-care-only revenue. Add the $4.70 HCAS/PC rate with its condition.

issues.current: 'The application must include a notarized affidavit verifying the applicant's identity' ($25–$100 cost line, cite ORC 3740.03).

issues.evidence: OAC 3701-60-03(B)(3)(g): "If the applicant for licensure is a home health agency, a copy of the home health agency's written criminal records check policy".
issues.fix: Make the affidavit task conditional on a nonagency provider. Add checklist tasks for drafting the written criminal records check policy and attaching the Secretary of State filed documents. Add a cost line for policy drafting if it is not covered by the policies manual.
